title: Letterbox / pillarbox payload
summary: JSON Schema for the letterbox/pillarbox detector payload - bar kind, per-side thickness in source px, colour, solid vs blurred-fill style and the content rectangle.
description: Emitted as the envelope payload by video_re_detect_letterbox_pillarbox; the envelope itself follows the baltor.video-detection/v1 schema.

review.notes: Valid example validates and invalid example fails (Draft 2020-12); the detector's tests validate every emitted payload against this schema.
